historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; reads a decoded extended end without proving legacy-sentinel activation, inclusive pairing or range ownership.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds conditional applicability and full inclusive-range validation but lowers capability for inputs.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; retained direct agent collection after operator target selection and command sanity review.
historical_reviews.second_review_handoff: No V3/V3.1 record exists for this variant.

original_test_intent: Validate Extended Ending Address for every applicable Type 19 range as the inclusive 64-bit final byte, only when the legacy Ending Address sentinel and structure length make it authoritative, with correct pairing/ownership and reboot persistence.
original_method: Collect complete raw Type 16/19/20 and OS-map data, verify version/length and legacy ending sentinel, pair the 64-bit extended end with Extended Starting Address, validate inclusive arithmetic/order/overlap and array ownership, and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves expected 64-bit inclusive ranges and reboot; no memory-map modification or physical action is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Legacy Ending Address sentinel and extended-field applicability
Expected Extended Starting/Ending ranges per Type 16 array
Inclusive-end, overlap and OS-map correlation policy
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and OS-map queries; never change mapping, firmware, kernel or DIMMs.
Use Extended Ending Address only when the legacy end sentinel and field length authorize it.
Preserve raw 64-bit byte addresses, pair with the same record's extended start and handle inclusive-end overflow safely.
Require approved reboot/recovery; stop on reversed/overlapping ranges or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Gate field authority, parse and pair 64-bit endpoints, validate inclusive range topology/ownership and compare pre/post reboot.
Report inapplicable, truncated, reversed, overlapping or drifting ranges without setting PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve extended-ending applicability, expected ranges/reservations and reboot plan.
Interpret allowed OS-map differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove sentinel activation, field presence, inclusive pairing, array ownership or overlaps.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 16/19/20 and OS map; report legacy sentinel, structure length, raw extended endpoints, normalized inclusive range, owner/topology checks and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Extended Ending Address scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no mapping change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Gate the extended end by sentinel/length, pair it with the 64-bit start, validate inclusive endpoint arithmetic, ownership and complete map topology, then compare after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 19 implementations with extended fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware, parser/dmidecode and OS-map versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 19 legacy sentinel and Extended Starting/Ending Address definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authority gating, inclusive arithmetic, pairing, ownership and overlap checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects inapplicable/ignored fields, off-by-one capacity, truncation and invalid 64-bit range topology missed by grep.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved 64-bit inclusive map and sentinel/applicability policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS maps contain reservations and the extended field is not authoritative outside its sentinel condition.

project_override_considerations: A project can choose legacy or extended representation according to platform range, but cannot waive sentinel/length and inclusive-end rules; expected maps must remain explicit.
expected_evidence: Approved sentinel/structure/inclusive-range policy and expected map
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/19/20 records with versions/lengths
Per-range sentinel, raw extended endpoints, normalized inclusive capacity, owner and overlap results
Read-only OS/e820 comparison with reservations identified
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Extended Ending Address is a valid conditional Type 19 field; expected map is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Authority gating, inclusive arithmetic and map validation are fully automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds sentinel/length authority, paired inclusive-range and ownership/topology checks.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains conditional-field safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing map/reboot inputs and engineer verdict from automation.

review_improvement: Prevents a displayed extended end from passing when inactive, unpaired, off by one, truncated or part of an invalid map.
independent_technical_reasoning: The ending field's distinctive requirement is conditional authority plus inclusive 64-bit arithmetic; both are deterministic software checks.
